name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest engineering and construction conglomerate: Projects & Manufacturing (infrastructure, hydrocarbon, power, process, heavy engineering, defence), IT & technology services via LTM (LTIMindtree) and LTTS, financial services via L&T Finance, and development projects (Hyderabad Metro, Nabha Power). Q2 FY27: revenue Rs78,750 cr (+16%), consolidated PAT Rs5,949 cr incl. minorities (attributable Rs5,202 cr, +33%), order inflows +28%. Mcap Rs5.57 lakh cr, P/E 29.5, +3% 12m.

revenue_mix.geography: India ~60% / international (mainly Middle East) ~40% of order book

exposures.mechanism: Domestic infra (roads, rail, metro, water, buildings) ~45% of order book (model estimate); +10% capex growth -> order inflow +4.5% -> revenue/EBITDA (margin ~9-10% incl. services) +4% over 12 months at flat margins; x EV/MCap 1.1 (financial arm) x persistence 0.5... +2.2; plus multiple support in capex-theme stock -> +3.5.

evidence.note: Q2: PAT +33% to Rs5,202 cr (ET), revenue +16%, order inflows +28%; shares +6% (Upstox); Reuters 27 Oct: profit beat eases Middle East concerns; Q2 orders near Rs1.3 lakh cr (Equitypandit 8 Oct)

exposures.mechanism: Process industries, hydrocarbon, power, data centres, defence ~30% of order book; +10% private capex growth -> inflows +3% -> EBITDA +3% x1.1 x0.5... + multiple -> +3.0.

evidence.note: order book split is model estimate

exposures.mechanism: Middle East ~35-40% of order book (model knowledge); +1pp GCC growth (oil-funded capex: Saudi/UAE/Qatar hydrocarbon, green hydrogen, transmission) -> inflows +4% -> EBITDA +3.5% x1.1 x0.5... +3.5 with sentiment. Aug-Oct 2026 wins: Rs10-15k cr Middle East ultra-mega order (Upstox 17 Aug) and Saudi/UAE/India orders (Business Today 5 Oct).

evidence.note: L&T wins Rs10,000-15,000 cr contract; orders in Saudi, UAE, India (Sahi/Business Today)

exposures.mechanism: Higher oil funds GCC capex and upstream/hydrocarbon awards (positive, +0.8 per +10%) but raises commodity/input cost and execution risk; net mildly positive. Empirical: none significant.

Steel/cement/copper are ~35% of project cost but most contracts have price-variation clauses (~70% covered); +7% steel -> costs +0.9% unrecovered ~0.3% -> EBITDA -3% x1.1 x0.2... -0.6. Empirical steel +0.61 (t +1.0) opposite sign (capex-cycle correlation).

Consolidated interest Rs9,900 cr TTM, mostly L&T Finance (66% held) and project debt; +25bp -> -Rs150 cr = -0.7% PBT; plus long-duration infra-capex multiple (P/E 29.5) -1.4. RBI hiked to 5.50% on 7 Oct; stock still +7.4% in 1m.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Reuters/The Hindu/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: International order book ~40% with USD/AED-linked revenue and partial natural hedge; LTM (IT) earns USD. +3% -> EBITDA +1.5% x1.1 x0.5.
Defence & aerospace ~5% of order book; +10% domestic orders -> inflows +1% -> +1.0.
L&T builds data centres (Lakshya, EPC) and owns LTM; theme supports both.
LTM (68%) and LTTS are ~10% of consolidated value; +5% US tech spend growth -> LTM revenue +3% -> look-through +0.5%... handled partly via link.

company_links.mechanism: L&T holds ~68.7% of LTM (model knowledge) worth ~Rs88k cr vs L&T mcap Rs5.57 lakh cr = 16%; after holdco discount ~0.12.
L&T holds ~66% of L&T Finance (model knowledge) worth ~Rs46k cr = 8% of L&T mcap; after discount ~0.08.

supply_chain.counterparty: Government of India, state governments, NHAI, Railways
BHEL, Tata Projects, Adani Infra, NCC

Large (>Rs10,000 cr) order announcements, Middle East/hydrocarbon/green hydrogen
